files.content:
PBR-003 multi-root workspace, root A.
marker=root-a

def greet(name: str) -> str:
    return f"hello {name}"

PBR-003 multi-root workspace, root B.
marker=root-b

def greet(name: str) -> str:
    return f"hi {name}"
